scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n API,WEB -c cyan,green "npm run dev -w backend" "npm run dev -w frontend"
scripts.build: npm run build -w backend && npm run build -w frontend
scripts.test: npm run test -w backend && npm run test -w frontend
scripts.format: prettier --write frontend/src frontend/scripts frontend/vite.config.ts backend/src backend/test backend/scripts *.json frontend/*.json backend/*.json
